Closed doors

Demand comes in waves

The Turning Community is closed until early 2027, the Next Chapter in Love group is a waitlist and the retreat sells once a year. A woman who finds you today often has nowhere to say yes this month.

No bridge

From a reel straight to a Google Form

Today the path is a reel or a podcast episode, then a $4,000 application. Nothing in between lets her feel what working with you is like before she raises her hand.

Linear growth

Every lead depends on the next post

1,384 posts and a podcast in, new applications still rise and fall with how much you publish. That lever is capped by your time.

Most of the women who follow you for your honesty about the messy middle never get an easy way to pay you, and the few ready for 1:1 work can’t be told apart from the rest.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass, “Out of the Messy Middle”, as an always-on front door to everything you already have

The class runs every week from ads, offers The Next Chapter to women not ready for 1:1 yet, and sends the women who are ready into the application and call you already use.

Who this class is for

Life didn’t follow the timeline. That might be the best thing that ever happened to you.

  • She looks around and feels like everyone else got the memo she missed.
  • Career, love, friendships: something feels stuck, and she can’t name why.
  • She’s tired of comparing her life to other people’s highlight reels.
  • She wants a bigger life, on her own terms, and is ready to start.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why the “by 30” timeline keeps you stuck

Where the milestones came from, and why measuring yourself against them drains your confidence.

Reflect

The journaling questions I use with clients to get honest about where you are and what you actually want.

Accept

How to make peace with the messy middle instead of fighting it, so you can stop comparing and start choosing.

Take action

Small, brave moves that build the confidence loop, in your career, your relationships and your friendships.

Your next-chapter plan

A simple one-page plan you’ll leave with, so the class turns into real change the week after.

Meet Emma

Hi, I’m Emma Wilson

I’m a life coach and the host of the Turning 30 Podcast. At 29, I felt like I hadn’t reached any of the milestones I was “supposed to”. So I did three things: I reflected, I accepted and I took action.

For 9 years I’ve been guiding women in their 30s through the messy middle, through 1:1 coaching, my courses, The Turning Community and retreats in Thailand.
